summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host identifiers on install
details: @umschool/analytics@999.0.2 is a dependency-confusion squat targeting the @umschool scope. The package ships an empty stub main (init/track/identify no-ops) and a postinstall.js that runs at npm install time. postinstall.js reads os.hostname(), os.userInfo(), process.cwd(), /etc/hostname, /proc/version and the Node version, base64-encodes them, and beacons the data to akko.requestcatcher.com over two channels: an HTTPS GET to /dep-confusion?data=<base64> and DNS lookups of dep.<label>.akko.requestcatcher.com / rce.<label>.akko.requestcatcher.com subdomain labels. The 999.0.2 version number is chosen to win resolution against an internal @umschool/analytics package, and the postinstall fires automatically on any machine that resolves this name from the public npm registry, sending installer host identifiers to a third-party out-of-band callback service.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
